findings.description: No explicitly labeled incoming faculty found on official EE faculty pages (www2.eecs.berkeley.edu/Faculty/Lists/EE/faculty.html and ee_list) as of observation date. Primary roster enumeration complete: 108 people on EE Faculty List. 65 included (57 regular, 2 in_residence, 6 joint_secondary), 43 excluded (36 emeritus/retired, 4 adjunct, 3 teaching/lecturer).
